settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

2. How we use data

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and site data is kept separate from other storefronts.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this storefront. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, ledger, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@dreamshootai.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.body:

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the current storefront and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in the ledger.

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@dreamshootai.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.title: Refunds and reversals
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used. Once credits have been spent on a successful generation, that purchase becomes non-refundable.

Refund window

Refund requests should be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date with your account email and purchase details.

Subscriptions

If a subscription is canceled, the customer keeps access to purchased credits until they are used or expire according to the plan rules. Cancellation does not automatically refund credits already used.

Technical failures

If a technical failure on our side prevents credit use or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the job, or approve a refund after review.

Ledger handling

Refunds and billing reversals are recorded against this storefront. Checkout completion never grants credits before payment confirmation, and every adjustment is written through the credit ledger.

1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and site data is kept separate from other storefronts.

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this storefront. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, ledger, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@dreamshootai.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

2. How we use data

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and site data is kept separate from other storefronts.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this storefront. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, ledger, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@dreamshootai.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the current storefront and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in the ledger.

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

2. How we use data

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and site data is kept separate from other storefronts.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this storefront. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, ledger, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@dreamshootai.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Terms of service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the current storefront and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in the ledger.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@dreamshootai.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.title: Refunds and reversals
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used. Once credits have been spent on a successful generation, that purchase becomes non-refundable.

Refund window

Refund requests should be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date with your account email and purchase details.

Subscriptions

If a subscription is canceled, the customer keeps access to purchased credits until they are used or expire according to the plan rules. Cancellation does not automatically refund credits already used.

Technical failures

If a technical failure on our side prevents credit use or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the job, or approve a refund after review.

Ledger handling

Refunds and billing reversals are recorded against this storefront. Checkout completion never grants credits before payment confirmation, and every adjustment is written through the credit ledger.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

2. How we use data

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and site data is kept separate from other storefronts.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this storefront. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, ledger, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@dreamshootai.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Terms of service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the current storefront and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in the ledger.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@dreamshootai.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.title: Refunds and reversals
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used. Once credits have been spent on a successful generation, that purchase becomes non-refundable.

Refund window

Refund requests should be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date with your account email and purchase details.

Subscriptions

If a subscription is canceled, the customer keeps access to purchased credits until they are used or expire according to the plan rules. Cancellation does not automatically refund credits already used.

Technical failures

If a technical failure on our side prevents credit use or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the job, or approve a refund after review.

Ledger handling

Refunds and billing reversals are recorded against this storefront. Checkout completion never grants credits before payment confirmation, and every adjustment is written through the credit ledger.
